en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Muhammad Bin Yahya Al Khash’amy, from Muhammad Bin Bahloul Al Abdy who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Allahazwj does not Secure the Momin from the turbulence of the world, but Heazwj Secures him from the blindness (disbelief) in it, and the misery in the Hereafter’.
en.sarwar: 18. Ali has narrated from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khath’ami from Muhammad ibn Bulul al-‘Abdi who has said the following:
“I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘Allah has not protected the believers from the turmoil of the world but He has protected them from blindness in it and the wickedness of the next life.’”
